member.name: M:RaceDay.API.Controllers.AuthController.Login(RaceDay.API.Dtos.LoginRequest)
member.summary: Logs a user in and returns a JWT access token.
member.remarks: Copy the returned token, click the Authorize button in Swagger and paste it in. It is then sent as "Authorization: Bearer {token}" on every request. The token carries the user's ID and role.

member.name: M:RaceDay.API.Controllers.AuthController.Logout
member.summary: Logs the user out: the token used for this request stops working immediately.
member.remarks: The API remembers the token's unique ID, so any later request that uses the same token gets 401. The client should also discard the token. Other tokens (for example a login on another device) are not affected.
member.response: Not logged in, or the token was already logged out.

member.name: T:RaceDay.API.Services.BlobStorageService
member.summary: Stores uploaded images in Azure Blob Storage. The connection string is read from configuration ("AzureBlobStorage:ConnectionString") and must come from User Secrets or an environment variable, never from a file in the repository. The client is created on first use, so the API still starts (and the unit tests still run) when no storage account is configured. The containers are private: the browser never receives the Azure URL, the API serves the image itself.
